title: abap2UI5 roundtrip response, protocol 3
description: The JSON body of a successful (2xx) roundtrip response (spec/response.md). Keys this schema does not name are allowed - a later additive revision of protocol 3 may add some, and a frontend ignores what it does not know (spec/versioning.md).

MODEL.description: The COMPLETE view model of the app that answered. Absent when nothing bound changed - the frontend keeps the model it has (spec/response.md#model).

__WINDOW.description: The window states of the app's windowed tables, mirroring their model paths: /__WINDOW/T_ROWS for the table at /T_ROWS, /__WINDOW/S_DATA/T_ROWS for one in a structure, /__WINDOW/MR_TAB/* for one behind a data reference (spec/windowed-tables.md#the-window-state). Absent when the app has none.

windowNode.description: A window state, or the path segments on the way to one. A window state is told by its SIZE, which is never 0 and so always sent.

windowState.description: The state of one windowed table: TOTAL - the rows there are in all, as the app reports them, at least COUNT; COUNT - the rows the app holds, which the model carries at the table's path; SIZE - the rows the frontend asks for at a time; EVENT - the app's event a window request names. The reference leaves out a TOTAL or COUNT of 0 - read a missing one as 0.

ID.description: The draft id the next request continues (spec/sessions.md).

APP.description: The app class that answered, upper case.

PROTOCOL.description: The wire protocol the backend speaks (spec/versioning.md).

VIEWS.description: What this response says about the view slots: one entry per slot it displays or tears down. A slot it does not name stays as it is. The frontend applies the entries in slot order - MAIN, NEST, NEST2, POPUP, POPOVER - whatever order the keys are in (spec/response.md#views).

ACTIONS.description: Follow-up actions the app queued, run in order once the views of this response are built (spec/actions.md).

slotEntry.description: A display - { "XML": <view>, "OPT": <options>? } builds the view into the slot, replacing what it holds - or a teardown - { "DESTROY": true }. Never both.

XML.description: The view, in the view profile's format (profiles/ui5.md#views). An empty view is still a display.

id.description: NEST/NEST2: the id of the control that receives the nested view.

methodInsert.description: NEST/NEST2: the mutator that inserts it (addItem, addContent, ...).

methodDestroy.description: NEST/NEST2: the mutator that clears the anchor first.

openById.description: POPOVER: the id of the control it opens by.

switchDefaultModelPath.description: MAIN: an OData service URL installed as the view's default model.

transition.description: MAIN: the page transition the view arrives with.

navBack.description: MAIN: the view is reached by going back (nav_app_leave to a stacked app).

appInstance.description: MAIN: an opaque id of the app instance the view belongs to.

navOptions.description: The browser-history intent of this response (spec/navigation.md#the-nav-section). Absent when the response has none.

action.description: ["<ACTION>", arg...] - a follow-up action; arguments are strings, an option object as the last one where the action takes one (spec/actions.md).

onClose.description: A backend event raised when the toast closes.
A backend event raised when the box closes; the pressed action is its first argument.
